maddeler.e:
تعاقدت (form VI)
# تَعَاقَدْتُ (taʕāqadtu) /ta.ʕaː.qad.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَاقَدَ (taʕāqada)
# تَعَاقَدْتَ (taʕāqadta) /ta.ʕaː.qad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَاقَدَ (taʕāqada)
# تَعَاقَدْتِ (taʕāqadti) /ta.ʕaː.qad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَاقَدَ (taʕāqada)
# تَعَاقَدَتْ (taʕāqadat) /ta.ʕaː.qa.dat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
